material.acceptance_criteria: CI job 'build once - workspace, test binaries, page wasm and map image' runs node js/host/guest.js --ticks=5000 --reps=5 --peers=1,8,32 on the green tip and prints ratio=<x> base_peers=1 top_peers=32 ceiling=1.5 with RESULT PASS (ratio <= 1.5). Two-sided check: node js/host/guest.js --ticks=5000 --reps=5 --peers=1,8,32 --inject-superlinear prints RESULT FAIL and exits 1.
material.description: Per-tick guest cost with 32 peers must stay within a committed per-peer ratio of the 1-peer cost. Decision (final, gm-orch-17-peers): the literal 32x acceptance is replaced by the per-peer ratio ceiling 1.5 (ratio = per_peer_ms at top peers / per_peer_ms at base peers, computed by js/host/guest.js with --peers=1,8,32). The gate is native: js/host/guest.js prints per-peer ratios for peers 1, 8 and 32, exits 0 on RESULT PASS and 1 on FAIL. --inject-superlinear must FAIL.
material.resolution: Per-peer ratio ceiling 1.5 replaces the literal 32x acceptance (decision gm-orch-17-peers).
material.subject: Per-tick guest cost under many peers is not measured
material.witness: Local: node js/host/guest.js --ticks=5000 --reps=5 --peers=1,8,32 -> ratio=0.518 base_peers=1 top_peers=32 ceiling=1.5, RESULT: PASS, exit 0. With --inject-superlinear -> ratio=4.501, RESULT: FAIL per-peer ratio 4.501 > 1.5, exit 1. CI tip f8ab06431a6a8fdf04e4845dbc7fb79eecbce3cd build-once job (117531052143, success) printed ratio=0.160 base_peers=1 top_peers=32 ceiling=1.5 from node js/host/guest.js --peers=1,8,32.
material.witness_plan: ci-status on the green tip shows the build-once job success (its peer-scaling step ran guest.js and printed the ratio). Local witness: run guest.js PASS (exit 0) and guest.js --inject-superlinear FAIL (exit 1), both recorded in the dispatch ledger.

note: Per-peer ratio ceiling 1.5 replaces the literal 32x acceptance (decision gm-orch-17-peers).
